policy.en: Discovery observes people and places already filtering emerging work. Sensors are not proof. Primary sources are required before a claim is treated as verified. Candidates need not fit Core Atlas taxonomy.
policy.ja: 発見は、新興の仕事を既に選別している人や場所を観測する。センサーは証明ではない。主張を検証済みとする前に一次資料が必要である。候補はコア・アトラスの分類に合わせる必要はない。

note.en: Surfaced by phenomenon queries for typed probabilistic decisions / System One models, not by searching a product name.
note.ja: 製品名検索ではなく、型付き確率的判断 / システムワンという現象クエリで浮上した。

candidates.durableConcept: State + bounded typed questions → typed answers, probabilities, and confidence without free-text parsing

whyInteresting.en: Microsoft-Decision-1 adds a major enterprise-hosted path and Mapika decider adds an open model/training/serving family; interface novelty is commoditized while deployment choice broadens.
whyInteresting.ja: Microsoft-Decision-1が主要企業のホスト経路を、Mapika deciderが公開モデル・学習・配信群を追加。インターフェースの新規性はコモディティ化し、配備選択肢は広がった。

implementations.access: hosted multimodal API

implementations.access: Apache-2.0 CPU and GPU models

implementations.access: Apache-2.0 training, weights, evaluation, and serving

implementations.name: Microsoft-Decision-1
implementations.access: hosted in Microsoft Foundry

implementations.name: decider model family
implementations.access: Apache-2.0 open models, training, evaluation, and serving

whyInteresting.en: Jev remains a visible comparison target, but Microsoft-Decision-1 now supplies the same typed state-and-question primitive through a major enterprise platform without a new Jev capability release.
whyInteresting.ja: Jevは目立つ比較対象のままだが、Jev自体の新機能リリースがない中、Microsoft-Decision-1が主要企業基盤から同じ状態・型付き質問プリミティブを提供する。

whyInteresting.en: The typed-decision pattern appearing as local/open-weight inference, not only a hosted API.
whyInteresting.ja: 型付き判断がホストAPIだけでなく、ローカル/オープンウェイト推論としても現れつつある。

whyInteresting.en: Typed questions scored in one forward pass over text, JSON, images, and video — the pattern leaving text-only APIs.
whyInteresting.ja: テキスト、JSON、画像、動画に対し、一回の前向き計算で型付き質問を採点する。テキスト専用APIから外へ出ている。

whyInteresting.en: Skill distribution is gaining governance and remote-discovery layers, while paired task evidence warns that indiscriminate skill injection is often neutral and can be harmful.
whyInteresting.ja: スキル配布に統治層と遠隔発見層が加わる一方、対比較タスク証拠は無差別なスキル注入が多くの場合中立で、害にもなり得ると警告する。

implementations.name: Vercel skills
implementations.access: open installer and updater

implementations.name: SkillFS / ANOLISA
implementations.access: open Linux/FUSE governance runtime

implementations.name: Cloudflare Skills over MCP
implementations.access: hosted MCP discovery and resource retrieval

whyInteresting.en: Typed tool contracts, native views, inspection, and deployment are converging into an application stack while the underlying MCP protocol is changing materially.
whyInteresting.ja: 型付きツール契約、ネイティブ表示、検査、デプロイがアプリケーションスタックへ収束する一方、基盤MCPプロトコルも大きく変化している。

whyInteresting.en: Uniform compaction can erase exact constraints; type-aware retention gives safety rules, episodic logs, and other knowledge different fidelity and retrieval policies.
whyInteresting.ja: 一様な圧縮は正確な制約を失わせ得る。型を考慮した保持は、安全規則、エピソード記録などに異なる忠実度と検索方針を与える。

whyInteresting.en: Tool reliability has two boundaries: verify plausible returns before trusting them, and delay or compensate external effects until the workflow has an explicit settlement decision.
whyInteresting.ja: ツール信頼性には二つの境界がある。もっともらしい戻り値を信頼前に検証し、外部効果を明示的な決済判断まで遅延または補償する。

whyInteresting.en: A named full-stack MCP implementation with concrete release movement, separate from the MCP Apps protocol category.
whyInteresting.ja: MCP Appsプロトコルカテゴリとは別の、具体的なリリース進展を持つ名前付きフルスタックMCP実装。

whyInteresting.en: A named coding-agent minimization skill with a persistent shortcut ledger; outcome evidence remains project-authored.
whyInteresting.ja: 永続的なshortcut台帳を持つ名前付きコーディングエージェント最小化スキル。成果証拠はプロジェクト自身の報告。

whyInteresting.en: A named reversible context and tool-result compression implementation with recoverable handles and deterministic fidelity checks.
whyInteresting.ja: 復元可能ハンドルと決定論的忠実度検査を持つ、名前付きの可逆コンテキスト・ツール結果圧縮実装。

whyInteresting.en: A high-attention universal work-agent launch combining persistent execution, cross-channel context, model routing, and identity-bearing sub-agents.
whyInteresting.ja: 永続実行、チャネル横断コンテキスト、モデルルーティング、固有ID付きサブエージェントを組み合わせた高注目の汎用業務エージェント発表。

whyInteresting.en: A high-attention named Agent Skills installer now discovers workspace, dependency, Git, and npm sources with explicit sync, removal, and lock behavior.
whyInteresting.ja: 高注目の名前付きAgent Skillsインストーラーが、ワークスペース、依存関係、Git、npmソースを発見し、明示的な同期、削除、ロック挙動を持つ。

candidates.durableConcept: Observe agent effects from an evaluator-controlled boundary rather than trusting self-reported trajectories or final outputs alone

whyInteresting.en: Independent OS/network observation and domain-runtime probes both expose behavior missed by outcome-only or model-judged evaluation.
whyInteresting.ja: 独立したOS・ネットワーク観測と領域実行時プローブの双方が、成果物のみ・モデル判定のみの評価が見逃す挙動を示す。

implementations.name: AgentSpy
implementations.access: research prototype described in a public preprint

implementations.name: SWE-Game evaluator instrumentation
implementations.access: research benchmark described in a public preprint

candidates.durableConcept: Resolve temporal validity and identity before retrieved memory enters the generation prompt

whyInteresting.en: Independent studies expose stale and misattributed context before generation, while Mem0 and Zep provide independently operated supersession and temporal-validity paths.
whyInteresting.ja: 独立研究が生成前の古い情報・誤帰属コンテキストを可視化し、Mem0とZepが独立運営の置換・時間的有効性経路を提供する。

implementations.name: Mem0 Dream active-memory reads
implementations.access: hosted memory supersession and latest-only retrieval

implementations.name: Zep / Graphiti temporal facts
implementations.access: managed and open temporal fact lifecycle and retrieval

whyInteresting.en: A high-attention MCP/CLI evidence layer for existing reverse-engineering tools, with concrete capability breadth and independent evidence of both correct locations and important misses.
whyInteresting.ja: 既存のリバースエンジニアリング道具をMCP/CLIから扱う高注目の証拠層。能力の広さに加え、正しい位置特定と重要な見逃しの両方を示す独立証拠がある。

whyInteresting.en: Anthropic now exposes a beta managed harness with persistent sessions, schedules, self-hosted execution, event streams, budgets, and agent-written parallel workflows.
whyInteresting.ja: Anthropicは、永続セッション、スケジュール、セルフホスト実行、イベントストリーム、予算、エージェント生成の並列ワークフローを備えたベータ版管理ハーネスを公開した。

candidates.durableConcept: Keep durable task state, evidence, queues, budgets, and verification outside any one model conversation; reconstruct bounded role-specific context for each invocation.

whyInteresting.en: Research and independently operated harnesses converge on externalized state, bounded fresh contexts, explicit queues, isolated workers, and deterministic verification for long-running agent work.
whyInteresting.ja: 研究と独立運営のハーネスが、外部化状態、限定された新規コンテキスト、明示的キュー、隔離ワーカー、決定論的検証へ収束している。

implementations.name: Stateless Language Agents framework
implementations.access: public preprint with author-run multi-domain evaluations

implementations.name: GitHub Agentic Workflows
implementations.access: open workflow harness with queues, ledgers, graders, routing, and sandbox controls

implementations.name: Claude Managed Agents dynamic workflows
implementations.access: hosted beta with persistent event history and managed or self-hosted sandboxes

implementations.name: Prime Agent finite-state orchestration
implementations.access: open-source harness with persistent sessions and vendor-operated multi-agent workflows

implementations.name: Temporal durable agent execution
implementations.access: durable workflow execution and replay primitives

whyInteresting.en: Draft 0.1 joins discovery, authorization, browser/API continuity, and company-agent conversations, but explicitly permits breaking changes and lacks a public conformance suite.
whyInteresting.ja: ドラフト0.1は発見、認可、ブラウザ/API継続性、企業エージェント会話を統合するが、破壊的変更を明示的に許容し、公開適合試験もない。

whyInteresting.en: Anthropic reports that agent-scale change volume forced a server-centric source-control and review redesign, but the systems are internal and their measurements are not independently reproducible.
whyInteresting.ja: Anthropicはエージェント規模の変更量がサーバー中心のソース管理・レビュー再設計を強いたと報告するが、システムは社内限定で測定値も独立再現できない。

whyInteresting.en: A hierarchical world-action model, orchestrator, controller, and robot complete an uncut hour-long laundry workflow; independent evidence supports sustained narrow folding, not general reliability.
whyInteresting.ja: 階層型ワールドアクションモデル、オーケストレータ、制御器、ロボットが無編集の1時間洗濯工程を完遂。独立証拠は狭い折り畳みの長時間運転を支持するが、汎用信頼性は支持しない。

whyInteresting.en: ACE binds verified agents, authenticated purchase intent, tokenized Amex credentials, spend controls, and dispute context, but access and public production evidence remain limited.
whyInteresting.ja: ACEは検証済みエージェント、認証された購入意図、トークン化Amex資格情報、支出制御、紛争文脈を結ぶが、利用範囲と公開本番証拠は限定的。

candidates.durableConcept: Bind agent identity, user intent, scoped credentials, transaction context, and audit evidence before an agent completes a purchase.

whyInteresting.en: American Express, Google, Visa, and Mastercard independently converge on verifiable agent identity, bounded user intent, scoped credentials, and transaction evidence while remaining fragmented across different protocol layers.
whyInteresting.ja: American Express、Google、Visa、Mastercardが、異なるプロトコル層で分断されたまま、検証可能なエージェントID、限定されたユーザー意図、範囲付き資格情報、取引証拠へ独立に収束している。

implementations.name: American Express ACE
implementations.access: controlled developer access with partially available service areas

implementations.name: Agent Payments Protocol (AP2)
implementations.access: open protocol specification and reference implementation

implementations.name: Trusted Agent Protocol (TAP)
implementations.access: developer documentation and limited deployment

implementations.name: Mastercard Agent Pay
implementations.access: network program with announced platform and acquirer partners

whyInteresting.en: A decision-model crawler claims lower cost and better answer-page selection, but its benchmark is author-run, JavaScript coverage is absent, and no independent task-success rerun was found.
whyInteresting.ja: 判断モデル型クローラーは低コストと回答ページ選択改善を主張するが、評価は作者実施でJavaScript対応がなく、独立した課題成功率の再実行も見つからない。

whyInteresting.en: Tracely turns selected production traces into hermetic replay cases and pull-request gates, a concrete path from observed failures to regressions; evaluator calibration and production impact remain unverified.
whyInteresting.ja: Tracelyは選択した本番トレースを密閉再生ケースとプルリクエストゲートへ変換し、観測障害から回帰試験への具体的経路を示す。評価器校正と本番効果は未検証。

whyInteresting.en: Context Mode combines output interception, local indexing and retrieval, and session continuity across many coding hosts; claimed compression is concrete, but task success and retrieval misses are not independently measured.
whyInteresting.ja: Context Modeは多数のコーディングホストで出力遮断、ローカル索引・検索、セッション継続を統合する。圧縮主張は具体的だが、課題成功率と検索漏れは独立測定されていない。

whyInteresting.en: Agent37 exposes persistent isolated computers with explicit stop/start, backup/restore, sleep/wake, and stable HTTPS lifecycle contracts; throughput, recovery reliability, and isolation claims remain untested here.
whyInteresting.ja: Agent37は停止・開始、バックアップ・復元、スリープ・復帰、安定HTTPSを明示した永続隔離コンピュータを提供する。処理量、復旧信頼性、隔離主張はここでは未試験。

whyInteresting.en: Capsem makes per-session VM isolation, inspected egress, policy, MCP routing, and telemetry concrete, but 0.6 remains pre-release and the repository explicitly disclaims official Google support.
whyInteresting.ja: Capsemはセッション別VM隔離、検査付き外向き通信、方針、MCPルーティング、遠隔測定を具体化するが、0.6はプレリリースで、リポジトリはGoogle公式支援を明示的に否定する。

candidates.durableConcept: Move agent verification out of self-reported completion and into versioned fixtures, frozen submissions, held-out cases, replayable environments, and explicit scoring contracts.

whyInteresting.en: iFixAi, AgentSWE, and ReviewBench independently package verification as inspectable artifacts rather than prompts, while measuring different targets and retaining judge and transfer limits.
whyInteresting.ja: iFixAi、AgentSWE、ReviewBenchは独立に、検証をプロンプトではなく検査可能な成果物として構成する。ただし対象は異なり、判定モデルと転移の限界が残る。

implementations.name: iFixAi
implementations.access: open fixed inspections, rubrics, fixtures, and scorecards

implementations.name: AgentSWE
implementations.access: public paper, code, tasks, frozen submissions, and held-out acceptance cases

implementations.name: ReviewBench
implementations.access: open corpus, golden findings, container contract, and leaderboard harness

whyInteresting.en: Minos packages a replayable physical-science environment, but the evidence remains author-run and one implementation is not enough to establish a durable category.
whyInteresting.ja: Minosは再生可能な物理科学環境を構成するが、証拠は作者実施に留まり、単一実装では耐久カテゴリを成立させられない。
